Ahuka.note: A Yadava patriarch; father of Devaka and Ugrasena.

people.Devaka: Yadava prince, son of Ahuka; father of Devaki.
people.Ugrasena: Yadava king of Mathura, son of Ahuka; deposed by his son Kamsa and restored by Krishna.
people.Kamsa: Son of Ugrasena; the tyrant of Mathura who jailed Devaki and Vasudeva and was slain by the young Krishna.

Devaki.note: Daughter of Devaka, wife of Vasudeva and mother of Krishna; her first sons were killed by her cousin Kamsa.

people.Shurasena: Yadava chief of the Vrishnis; father of Vasudeva and of Pritha (Kunti), which makes Krishna and the Pandavas cousins.
people.Vasudeva: Son of Shurasena; father of Krishna, Balarama and Subhadra. Imprisoned by Kamsa, he bore the newborn Krishna across the river to safety.

Kunti.note: Born Pritha, daughter of Shurasena; given in adoption to the childless Kuntibhoja and renamed Kunti. By a sage's boon she could summon any god to father a child, hence Karna and the three eldest Pandavas.

Shrutashrava.note: Daughter of Shurasena, sister of Vasudeva; wed to Damaghosha of Chedi and mother of Shishupala.

Kuntibhoja.note: A childless Bhoja king, cousin of Shurasena; he adopted Pritha, who took his name as Kunti.

people.Krishna: Son of Vasudeva and Devaki; the eighth child, an avatar of Vishnu, spirited to Gokula the night he was born. Counsellor and charioteer of Arjuna, speaker of the Bhagavad Gita. Beyond his eight principal queens (the Ashtabharya) he wed the sixteen thousand one hundred women he freed from the demon Narakasura's captivity, giving each of them honour and a home.
people.Balarama: Elder half-brother of Krishna, son of Rohini; wielder of the plough and mace, teacher of both Bhima and Duryodhana.

Subhadra.note: Sister of Krishna, daughter of Rohini; she eloped with Arjuna at Krishna's urging and became the mother of Abhimanyu.

people.Pradyumna: Son of Krishna and Rukmini; a rebirth of Kamadeva, the god of love.
people.Samba: Son of Krishna and Jambavati; his prank on the sages drew the curse that destroyed the Yadava race.
people.Aniruddha: Son of Pradyumna; carried off by Usha, daughter of the asura Bana, and rescued by Krishna.
people.Vajra: Great-grandson of Krishna; after the Yadavas destroyed themselves he was made their king, so the line survived.

Satrajit.note: A Yadava noble, keeper of the Syamantaka gem; father of Satyabhama.
